headline: NK Industries Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Nimish Keshavlal Patel filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a regulated threshold crossing in NK Industries Limited's shareholding.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, a mandatory filing requirement triggered when an acquirer crosses specified shareholding thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50%, or 75%) in a listed company. The filing was dated 6 May 2026 and filed to the exchange on that date. This is a regulatory compliance notification that must be accompanied by a detailed Form DCR (Disclosure of Change in Regulation) containing the acquirer's identity, the shareholding percentage acquired, the manner and timing of acquisition, and past shareholding history.
